# fjordrun_user (Data Source)

The user the provider's token belongs to, with their teams. With a team API token that is the token's creator, and only the token's team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_user" "me" {}

output "email" {
  value = data.fjordrun_user.me.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) Avatar URL.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `github_login` (String) Linked GitHub account.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `is_staff` (Boolean) Whether this is Fjordrun staff.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `product_emails` (Boolean) Whether they get product emails.
- `referral_code` (String) Referral code.
- `teams` (Attributes List) Their teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `founding_member` (Boolean) Whether it has founding member benefits.
- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace.
- `plan` (String) `trial`, `hobby`, `pro` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The caller's role.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended`.
